name: Kisaragi Rei
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c22211]Yuuji[/url]'s upperclassman and one of the top students at school. She is generally level-headed and responsible, but doesn’t seem to take things too seriously. She is also a shrine maiden at her family’s shrine that has been taking care of the strange sakura tree for ages. 

[Edited from [url=http://animehistory.wordpress.com/2008/03/23/snow-sakura-visual-novel/]Anime History[/url]]
